Good morning, Shahriaar. Today is Wednesday, November 11. This is your morning brief.

Weather today is 2 degrees Celsius, clear skies. The high will be 10 and the low 2 degrees Celsius. Chance of precipitation is 80 percent.

You have 3 appointments in the next 24 hours: 8:15 AM, Bank Mellat; 11:00 AM, Arak Hybrid Sales Cost; 3:00 PM, Design.

Now, the top 5 stories in AI today.

First, from Ars Technica: Ring cameras go mobile as Amazon debuts AI-powered security drone and robot. Amazon's roaming Ring Robotics devices will debut in late 2026 and early 2027.

Second, from Ars Technica: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI. Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.

Third, from TechCrunch: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder. OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

Fourth, from TechCrunch: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect. New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

Fifth, from Ars Technica: What happens to mathematics when AI becomes an oracle? Mathematician Steven Strogatz discusses his new book, Big Math: The Hidden Codes That Run Our World .

That is your brief. Have a great day.
